hero.label: Optimal revenue
hero.verdict: The model identifies high-elasticity windows worth investing in. Increasing promo spend by 5546712.1× unlocks 21% more revenue. The commercial case is volume growth: more targeted investment, more turnover.
hero.data_sub: Trained on 2 years of causal data (2024–2025) · 14 SKUs selected

why_reasons.title: Top 3 SKUs account for 64% of portfolio opportunity
why_reasons.body: HX9911/89, HX9911/09, HX9992/11 together drive 64% of the total revenue uplift (+1,289,692.59 €). Concentrate promo investment on these for highest impact.

why_reasons.title: Weeks 12–29 are your highest-elasticity window
why_reasons.body: The causal model shows strongest price response in weeks 12–29 — 852,359.30 € incremental revenue available here. Concentrate promo activity in this window.

why_reasons.title: Optimal depth averages 11% across the portfolio
why_reasons.body: The causal response curve is concave — beyond 11% discount, additional depth adds cost without meaningful volume gain.
